summary: CICS online Transaction View screen. The user enters a transaction id; the program validates it, reads the transaction record, and displays its full detail (account/card, type, category, amount, dates, merchant). Read-only inquiry. Pseudo-conversational.

paragraphs.name: MAIN-PARA
paragraphs.pseudocode: Pseudo-conversational entry. On first entry send the transaction-view screen. On re-entry evaluate the key: PF3 return; Enter validate the transaction id and read+display it. Return to CICS with the COMMAREA.

paragraphs.name: PROCESS-ENTER-KEY
paragraphs.pseudocode: Validate the transaction id is present and correctly formatted; read the transaction and, if found, display it; if not found show a 'transaction not found' error.
branches: IF not found -> error ELSE display

annotations.note: BUSINESS RULE: transaction id must be present and valid; a missing transaction is reported, not created.

paragraphs.name: READ-TRANSACT-FILE
paragraphs.pseudocode: Read the transaction record by id (CICS READ); on not-found set an error.

paragraphs.name: SEND-TRNVIEW-SCREEN
paragraphs.pseudocode: Populate the header and transaction fields and send the transaction-view map.

paragraphs.name: RECEIVE-TRNVIEW-SCREEN
paragraphs.pseudocode: Receive the transaction-view map from the terminal.

paragraphs.name: POPULATE-HEADER-INFO
paragraphs.pseudocode: Populate the screen header (title, date, time, ids).

paragraphs.name: RETURN-TO-PREV-SCREEN
paragraphs.pseudocode: Return control to the previous menu/screen.

paragraphs.name: INITIALIZE-ALL-FIELDS
paragraphs.pseudocode: Initialize all map fields to defaults.
